svg.title: Four-Week Hardware and Vault Cash Launch
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-atm-hardware-launch-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Four-Week Hardware and Vault Cash Launch; subtitle: Machine vetting through vaulter controls; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Vet the machine; deliverable: Model number, manufacture date, software version, both passwords and the combo, with EMV and TLS 1.2 as the floor; gate: Processing company clears the unit before payment; week: Week 2; title: Delivery and programming; deliverable: Tip indicator checked, clock set to current time, Spanish enabled alongside English where needed; gate: Surcharge setting confirmed enabled; week: Week 3; title: Vault cash plan; deliverable: Budget $4,200 to $6,200 per week for each busy location; gate: $16,000 minimum on hand across three busy locations; week: Week 4; title: Vaulter agreement and reconciliation; deliverable: Signed terms at 70 cents to $1.25 per transaction with fill levels, response times, penalties, and a lead clause; gate: Daily and monthly reconciliation against settlement deposits; caption: The machine is the business and vault cash is the bottleneck, so every step locks down hardware integrity and cash control.; assumptions note: Weekly pacing is an editorial sequence; vault cash needs reflect locations running 283 to 350 transactions.; note: Sources include ATMDepot, ATM Connect, Rocket ATM, and Philip Webb.
